rows.needed: For the actual negative odd fundamental k0 and E^h, w(E^(hk0))=w(E^h)chi_k0(-N_(E^h))=+1.
rows.argument: Use rho=chi_k0 on E^h. The fixed actual k0 is negative odd fundamental, prime to N_(E^h). Its local-square requirements at every prime of2Nh imply chi_k0(N_(E^h))=1: E^h has good reduction away from2Nh, so its conductor has no other support. Since chi_k0(-1)=-1 and w(E^h)=-1 from the prepared odd-sign filter, the twist has root number+1. This does not choose k0, prove the filter or assert uniform analytic constants.
incoming: Actual prepared odd-sign filter gives w(E^h)=-1.

rows.needed: For the actual fixed negative odd fundamental hstar prime to2N, w(E^hstar)=w(E)chi_hstar(-N).
rows.argument: Use rho=chi_hstar on E. The actual hstar is negative odd fundamental and a square at primes of2N, as specified3279–3285 and14830–14842. Thus its conductor is coprime to N and the theorem gives exactly w(E^hstar)=w(E)chi_hstar(-N). The independent identity w(E)=-product w_(p^e) and the nonzero-central-value sign are not supplied by this source.
incoming: Actual fixed genus partner hstar and coprimality; separate global Atkin sign normalization and sign from nonvanishing.

rows.argument: Use the quadratic twist isomorphism and its negative conjugate to define the two sum-and-difference maps with both composites [2]. Global and semilocal Shapiro compare full discrete Selmer groups; functoriality of division-point Kummer cocycles preserves every local condition. Kernels and cokernels are killed by2. Dualize and tensor Q2; multiplication2 is now invertible, proving the dimension sum.
